course_description: This course focuses on the development of applications using web, mobile and emerging technologies with emphasis on requirements management, interface, design, usability, testing and deployment, including ethical and legal considerations.

course_learning_outcomes.text: interpret the difference of front-end and back-development in web application;
design and identify web Development concept by dealing with client-based case study. ;
implement Object Oriented way of programming; 1
Understand how to manage website using Model, View and Control;
develop and deploy complete Web Application in live server for pilot testing; and
demonstrate 21st century skills in all learning activities.
